summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) to register the offer and sale of up to $53.9M of ordinary shares via an at-the-market offering through agents Cantor Fitzgerald and Mizuho. The shares trade on Nasdaq under NNOX at $1.08 per share (last sale July 21, 2026). Agents receive 3.0% commission; no escrow or trust. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation, as it covers ongoing capital raising under an existing sales agreement with no event-driven change of control, restructuring, or activist element.
